database_note: The payment and rental tables record transactions. The actor, address, category, city, country, customer, film, inventory, language, staff, and store tables describe entities. The film_actor and film_category tables link films to actors and categories. Connect customer to address via address_id, to store via store_id, and to rental via customer_id. Link rental to inventory via inventory_id, to customer via customer_id, and to staff via staff_id. Connect payment to rental via rental_id, to customer via customer_id, and to staff via staff_id. Associate inventory with film via film_id and store via store_id. Tie staff to store via store_id and address via address_id. Link store to address via address_id and to staff via manager_staff_id. Connect city to country via country_id and to address via city_id. Associate film with language via language_id and original_language_id.
database_fact: The payment and rental tables record transactions. The actor, address, category, city, country, customer, film, inventory, language, staff, and store tables describe entities. The film_actor and film_category tables link films to actors and categories. Customer connects to address via address_id, to store via store_id, and to rental via customer_id. Rental links to inventory via inventory_id, to customer via customer_id, and to staff via staff_id. Payment connects to rental via rental_id, to customer via customer_id, and to staff via staff_id. Inventory associates with film via film_id and store via store_id. Staff ties to store via store_id and address via address_id. Store links to address via address_id and to staff via manager_staff_id. City connects to country via country_id and to address via city_id. Film associates with language via language_id and original_language_id.
